title: The Indian Financial Automated Advice Bias (IFAAB) Dataset : Auditing Socioeconomic and Demographic Disparities in LLM-Generated Financial Advice in India
abstract: arXiv:2610.38239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for financial guidance, yet little is known about whether their advice changes across social identities in Global South contexts. We introduce the Indian Financial Automated Advice Bias (IFAAB) benchmark, a counterfactual audit dataset of 31,734 GPT-4o-generated financial-advice responses for synthetic Indian personas varying by gender, caste, education, employment, residence, age, and district. Holding the underlying request fixed, we evaluate disparities in LLM-implied wealth, income, savings, projected gains, textual similarity, advice topics, and qualitative bias judgments. In the gender-only audit, male-labelled profiles receive 60.1\% higher initial total resources and 46.8\% higher post-advice total resources than comparable female-labelled profiles; in the caste-augmented audit, the post-advice total-resource gap remains 49.4\%. translated_title: 印度金融自动建议偏差（IFAAB）数据集：审计印度大语言模型生成金融建议中的社会经济与人口统计差异
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于金融指导，但人们对其建议是否会因全球南方背景下的不同社会身份而发生变化知之甚少。我们提出了印度金融自动建议偏差（IFAAB）基准，这是一个反事实审计数据集，包含31,734条GPT-4o针对合成印度人设生成的金融建议回复，这些人设在性别、种姓、教育、就业、居住地、年龄和地区方面各不相同。在保持底层请求不变的情况下，我们评估了大语言模型隐含的财富、收入、储蓄、预期收益、文本相似度、建议主题以及定性偏差判断方面的差异。在仅考虑性别的审计中，男性标签的档案比可比的女性标签档案获得高出60.1%的初始总资源和46.8%的建议后总资源；在加入种姓信息的审计中，建议后总资源差距仍达49.4%。添加地区信息降低了总体建议后……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出IFAAB反事实审计数据集，对31,734条GPT-4o生成的针对不同印度人设的金融建议进行系统审计，揭示了大语言模型金融建议中存在显著的性别与种姓偏差（例如男性标签档案比女性高出60.1%的初始总资源）。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IFAAB, a counterfactual audit dataset of 31,734 GPT-4o-generated financial advice responses for synthetic Indian personas, revealing significant gender and caste disparities in LLM-generated financial advice, such as male-labelled profiles receiving 60.1% higher initial total resources than comparable female-labelled profiles.
